div.head: VI Atr 32.1
div.ab: ⁊ swa ymbe feos bote, þæt an mynet gange ofer ealle þas þeode butan ælcon false.
and swa ymbe feos bote, þæt an mynet gange ofer ealle þas þeode buton ælcon false.
⁊ swa ymbe feos bote þæt an mynet gange ofer ealle þas þeode butan ælcon false.
And swa ymbe feos bote, þæt an mynet gange ofer ealle þas þeode butan ælcon false.
und so auf Münzreform, dass Eine Münze über all dies Land hin gehe ohne jedes Falsch.
and on reform of the coinage, so that one coinage may be current throughout all this nation without any falseness.
And the coinage shall be improved by having one currency, free from all adulteration, throughout all the country.
The currency is to be improved so that there is one standard coinage throughout the realm without any adulteration.

note.label: reissue
note.quote: a reissue of (Wulfstan version of) Edgar's law on coin, weights and measures (n. 375: VI Atr 32:1-2 ...; III Eg 8 – 8:1)

note.label: residual parallel
note.quote: VI Atr 32:1-2 (only residually in V Atr 26:1, however)

note.label: expanded in
note.quote: id., 32.1 adds “so that one coinage is to be current throughout all this nation without anything false” … VI Ethelred 32.3 adds “and the supplying of ships also”

note.seg: Selbst wo Weltliches über V Atr hinaus ausgeführt wird, fehlt doch Strafdrohung.—Diese Einschaltung aus Eg scheint weniger authentisch als V Atr; s. o. Einl. 2 F. 11
Even where secular matters are elaborated beyond V Atr, a threat of penalty is nevertheless lacking.—This insertion from Eg seems less authentic than V Atr; see above Introduction 2 F. 11
